shellCommands.command: ls && cat package.json && ls app lib 2>/dev/null
cat app/page.tsx app/layout.tsx lib/api.ts next.config.ts tsconfig.json; echo "---VERSION---"; cat node_modules/next/package.json | head -20
cat node_modules/next/cache.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo "===CACHE JS==="; cat node_modules/next/cache.js 2>/dev/null | head -40

grep -rho "cacheComponents[^,}\"]\{0,80\}" node_modules/next/dist/build/index.js 2>/dev/null | head -5; echo "=== error msgs ==="; grep -rl "use cache.*cacheComponents\|cacheComponents.*use cache" node_modules/next/dist/ 2>/dev/null | head -10

grep -oh "To use \\\\\"use cache\\\\\"[^\"]\{0,200\}\|\"use cache\\\\\" requires[^\"]\{0,200\}" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/next-server/app-page.runtime.dev.js 2>/dev/null | head -5; echo "---2---"; grep -oh "useCacheEnabled\|cacheComponents.*must be enabled\|enable the .cacheComponents" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/next-server/app-page.runtime.dev.js | sort -u | head
